name: eyepin
author: eyepin

sections.description:
This Plugin adds Eyepin Support to WordPress.

External services

This plugin integrates with the eyepin API (https://apiv3.eyepin.com/interface3.php) to provide you to upload, update and delete posts in your eyepin account. You need an eyepin account to receive login credentials for the API.

Setup Instructions:

  1. Navigate to “eyepin”
  2. Enter the API username and API password, then click “Apply Changes.” You will receive the API user data from your eyepin account manager. Depending on the eyepin service you have subscribed to, there may be associated costs for access. Your account manager will inform you about this in advance.
  3. Select an eyepin client from the dropdown under “Mandanten” and confirm by clicking “Apply Changes.”

Troubleshooting: If you encounter any issues with the API connection, ensure your API username and API password is valid and that your server can make outbound HTTP requests.
This service is provided by eyepin GmbH:

Privacy policy

Troubleshooting:

If you encounter any issues with the API connection, ensure your API username and API password is valid and that your server can make outbound HTTP requests.

This plugin also integrates with Google reCAPTCHA to protect your site from spam and bots.

Setup Instructions:

Create Google reCAPTCHA Keys:

Visit Google reCAPTCHA Console.

Register your website and select either reCAPTCHA v2 or v3 (based on your plugin configuration).

Obtain the Site Key and Secret Key.

Enter reCAPTCHA Keys:

  1. Go to the WordPress “eyepin” menu and select Forms.
  2. Create a form using “Add New” or select an existing form.
  3. In the “Google ReCAPTCHA” sidebar, enter the site key and secret key, select the version, and then click “Update.”
  4. Confirm by clicking “Save.”

Using reCAPTCHA:

Once set up, Google reCAPTCHA will appear on the forms to help prevent spam submissions.

Troubleshooting:

If reCAPTCHA is not displaying correctly, ensure that the correct Site and Secret keys are entered and check your website’s JavaScript console for any errors.

Terms of use
Privacy policy

For more details, visit Google reCAPTCHA Documentation here.
